children: said post-market Tuesday that Jonathan Maurer plans to
from his role as co-CEO at the end of March 2027, which will leave Adam Comora as the company's sole chief executive.
Maurer has served as OPAL Fuels'

co-CEO since April 2021, shortly after the company was formed, after he was employed by Fortistar, a privately owned investment firm that is now the company's majority shareholder, since 1998; he was managing director and co-head of Fortistar's investment team.
Comora has been co-CEO since OPAL Fuels
was formed in December 2020, after spending 11 years at Fortistar, where among other positions he was President and CEO of TruStar Energy.

title: OPAL Fuels co-CEO Maurer to retire in March 2027
